source_contract.causal_vertex_eq4: Bianchi-Chen-Gamonal arXiv:2601.23162 Eq. (4): after fixing g_1=1 the vertex integrates four SL(2,C) variables and each K5 wedge contributes T^(sigma_a sigma_b) with magnetic indices m_ba,m_ab; boundary intertwiners contract the four magnetic indices at each node.
source_contract.gamma_simple_toller_eq9: Bianchi-Chen-Gamonal arXiv:2601.23162 Eq. (9), equivalently arXiv:2604.24945 Eq. (46), gives the exact gamma-simple reduced Toller matrix. At j=1/2 its beta->0 leading coefficients are t^+_{m=+1/2}=-C beta^-2, t^+_{m=-1/2}=+C beta^-2, t^-_{m=+1/2}=+C beta^-2, t^-_{m=-1/2}=-C beta^-2, with C=2/(1+gamma^2).
source_contract.cartan_rotation: For a boost in direction n, Cartan conjugation rotates sigma_z to n.sigma, hence T^(kappa)=-kappa*C*(n.sigma)*beta^-2+lower singular order at j=1/2, where kappa=+1 selects T+ and kappa=-1 selects T-.
source_contract.boundary_witness: Use normalized four-valent spin-1/2 SU(2)-invariant pairing tensors A=(epsilon_12 epsilon_34)/2 and B=(epsilon_13 epsilon_24)/2, with local neighbor order ascending. Choose node intertwiners (A,A,B,A,A).
source_contract.local_ray: Gauge-fix node 1 at x_1=0 and take five collinear boost coordinates x_a=(a-1) z for a=1..5, scaled by delta->0+. All pairwise separations are nonzero on the reference ray.
source_contract.scope: The audit targets local ABSOLUTE integrability of one legitimate fixed-spin, fixed-boundary-intertwiner causal-vertex component. It does not decide conditional, principal-value, distributional, or externally regularized definitions, nor the lambda_f-weighted complete stack or D7 transport.

scope_rule: A PASS refutes an unqualified absolute-convergence/finiteness claim for the fixed causal vertex as presently defined, by one explicit admissible boundary component. It must not be promoted to nonexistence of every conditional/distributional prescription, divergence of every boundary component, a family no-go, NEW_REQUIRED, or D7 authorization.
